```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
```


GTDB file
```{r}
gtdb <- read.delim("C:/Users/lacy_barrett/Downloads/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv", header = TRUE)

# Extract genus name from classification string
gtdb$genus <- sub(".*;g__([^;]+).*", "\\1", gtdb$classification)

```


still need contigs, can get it from checkm
```{r}
#this file is messy so have to do a few things to it
# Step 1: Read TSV as plain text
checkm <- read_tsv("C:/Users/lacy_barrett/Downloads/bin_stats_ext.tsv", col_names = c("file", "metadata"), col_types = "cc")

# Step 2: Convert the Python dict-like strings to valid JSON
checkm <- checkm %>%
  mutate(
    metadata_json = str_replace_all(metadata, "'", '"'),   # replace single quotes with double quotes
    metadata_json = str_replace_all(metadata_json, "None", "null")  # handle Python None if present
  )

# Step 3: Parse JSON into a list-column
checkm <- checkm %>%
  mutate(metadata_parsed = map(metadata_json, ~fromJSON(.x, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)))

# Step 4: Optionally, unnest into a flat table
checkm <- checkm %>%
  unnest_wider(metadata_parsed)

# Select only the desired columns
checkm <- checkm[, c("file", "# contigs", "Contamination", "Completeness", "Genome size")]

```


Now keep all columns from checkm but only keep bins that are in gtdb
```{r}

final_data <- checkm %>%
  semi_join(gtdb, by = c("file" = "user_genome")) %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb %>% 
      dplyr::select(user_genome, genus),
    by = c("file" = "user_genome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(file = sub("\\.fa$", "", file))


```

Rename and organize columns
```{r}
#clean up genome file name
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    file = str_replace(file, ".*?(\\d+).*\\.([0-9]+)$", "\\1.\\2")
  )


final_data <- final_data %>%
  rename(
    `Bin Identity` = `genus`,
    `Culture Origin` = `file`,
    `Bin completeness` = `Completeness`,
    `Bin contamination` = `Contamination`,
    `Number of contigs` = `# contigs`,
    `Size of genome (bp)` = `Genome size`
  )

#order it
final_data <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Bin Identity`, 
    `Culture Origin`, 
    `Bin completeness`, 
    `Bin contamination`, 
    `Number of contigs`, 
    `Size of genome (bp)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Bin Identity`)

```



export
```{r}
write.csv(final_data, "All_MAGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
